inlines.v: INWRAP, verb transitive inrap'. [in and wrap.] To involve; to infold; to cover by wrapping; as, to be inwrapped in smoke or in a cloud; to inwrap in a cloke. 1. To involve in difficulty or perplexity; to perplex. 2. To ravish or transport.
